analysis: The supplied units are base_text excerpts of docs/architecture/inference.md (base lines 2024-2838). The PR changes only documentation. It updates the 'Last updated' date, adds a paragraph (head lines ~3528-3536) about the cluster service heartbeat file via DARKBLOOM_CLUSTER_MEMBER_HEALTH_FILE, and rewrites the cluster runtime facts paragraph (head ~5230-5294) to say signed releases compute and register the cluster_runtime digests. The supplied base excerpts do not contain any of the changed ranges, so the changed text was reviewed only via the patch excerpt, which is truncated (patch_excerpt_complete=false). No code, config, key handling, authorization, attestation or encryption behavior changes in the supplied evidence, so no TB-002, TB-003, TB-007 or TB-011 control is touched. T-041 (prefix cache) is retrieved as relevant, but the unchanged base excerpts do not alter its mitigations. Remaining integration questions: (1) the cluster health-file separation (service-health.json vs part-health.json) and the supervisor liveness PID check live in code outside this batch. A part that misses its own heartbeat file could cause availability or supervision issues, which fall under A-018, but the code is not supplied. (2) The release-lane cluster_runtime digest registration is a trust-registration path (similar in spirit to A-011/A-017), and its implementation is not visible here. Neither is a finding, because documentation alone is not evidence of a regression. A reviewer of the code files in this PR should check those two points.
